items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And um...this input from outside of Detroit, and inside and from Saginaw would come people like Thad Jones... Frank Foster lived there for a while, he had a place. He worked at the Bluebird with Thad Jones.
